Chapter 6840: Forgotten Place

Chapter 6840: Forgotten Place

“Crack!” Slow cracking noises could be heard outside the core area, sounding as if turtles’ shells were hitting each other.

They came from a void zone filled with debris. Golden laws coiled around the boulders and slowly pulled them together, forming a new continent. However, this process could last for eras.

“Golden Lamp is still rebuilding.” Thunder Emperor said. The powers here prevented Golden Lamp from being utterly destroyed during each calamity.

Currently, the tree resembled a torch illuminating the sky and covering it with countless phenomena. There seemed to be another world that was not a part of Stygian. Perhaps it was just a lost dimension.

All in all, she had a tough time telling reality from illusions. How could there be another world connected to Golden Lamp?

Other phenomena confused her as well, making her wonder if they were images of the past. She saw a trail on the ground, seemingly left behind by a great insect. The mark was indelible and didn’t disappear with time...

All in all, she knew incredible battles had occurred here. Space and the dimensions were unstable.

“Where is Bear Immortal?” She couldn’t spot him. Alas, an emperor couldn’t see through all the visual phenomena.

“Over there.” Li Qiye pointed at a spatial crack.

It looked normal to her with flames oozing out. However, there was no immortal light or the special ring earlier.

“Where is it?” She found her cultivation to be insignificant, unable to see through the crack. In a sense, she was no different than an insect in this place.

“A forgotten place.” Li Qiye said and floated toward it, not forgetting to protect her from the Illumination.

Once they entered, they found another world.

“There’s another world in here?” She was surprised to see its size.

Unfortunately, she had always been in Golden Lamp and never had the chance to see the world. Any emperor from the major worlds wouldn’t be surprised.

“You have an inaccurate view of Stygian’s size. Limitless is one way to describe it, that’s how Devouring Alliance can hide so well in the hidden dimensions.” Li Qiye said.

She pondered briefly and agreed with this logic.

The world inside didn’t have any life, just like Stygian. However, it wasn’t covered in darkness, only stillness.

She saw shattered stars and only enough light to illuminate this desolate world. There were dilapidated palaces; some have collapsed entirely. A few remained untouched and majestic, floating in the sky and belonging to only the greatest cultivators.
